name: Arrowroot Lake
blurb: Sounding-derived bathymetry from a 2010 MNRF GPS spot-depth survey (2,115 soundings inside the lake, 0.4-13.7 m; year from the LIO bathymetry index). Depths are a thin-plate-spline fit of 25 m sounding nodes, capped at 15.1 m; confidence is distance-to-nearest-sounding (97.8% of water cells at >=0.4); held-out cross-validation MAE 0.29 m on 65 soundings. Cool-regime lake; walleye, smallmouth bass, northern pike in the ARA community. Secchi 4 m is a FALLBACK default (ARA Secchi null).

reasons: Point (310 m, 6 m contour) 4 m away

stocking.note: No MNRF stocking record for this waterbody in either layer - the lake may be wild-recruited, or stocked under a different waterbody id.
